_about: Known reds for THIS plugin's tests (UnrealToolbox v1.52+ reads this file in every project that contains the plugin). Only reds reproduced in the Ck home project (CkPlugins) belong here; a red that only one host shows stays in that host's own AutomationGate.json with the host coupling named.
Seeding rule: red = red in two full gates on one build AND red when run alone; flaky = red in at least one gate and green alone. Remove an entry in the PR that fixes the test.
